subject: Request: apply leftover promotional allocation across cohorts
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@launchpadaccelerator.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Cross-cohort promo allocation — possible?

Hi Ben,

Quick one — we ran a report and LaunchPad has ~$12K in unused Redwood promo allocation that was originally scoped to Cohort 05 (spring). Our next two cohorts (June + August) are smaller but would benefit if we could allocate the leftover credit across both.

Two questions:
- Is Redwood able to reassign unused promo credit across cohorts within the same accelerator program?
- If not, would you consider a one-time exception to split the remaining allocation between June and August cohorts? We can provide an updated participant list and expected usage.

We have an existing MPA (Master Promo Agreement) but I recall the promo terms referenced cohort-specific redemption. If we need a short amendment, we can run that through contracts.

Goal is to avoid wasting the credit and keep a smooth onboarding for startups in the next cohorts. Happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Thanks,
Samir Khan
Program Director | LaunchPad Accelerator
samir.k@launchpadaccelerator.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

---
Attachments: none
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@launchpadaccelerator.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-09T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-cohort promo allocation — possible?

Samir — thanks for the note and for flagging this. Short answer: we generally scope promos to the cohort they were issued for, but exceptions are possible with a quick approval from Programs + Finance.

Before I start the approval loop, can you confirm:
- Exact remaining promo balance (USD) and promo code/MPA reference.
- Names/emails of the startups that would consume the reallocated credit (June + August cohorts).
- Any expected spike patterns (e.g., first-week heavy usage) — helps with quota planning.

If you can paste that here I’ll route to LAURA (Programs) and MARISSA (Finance) and propose a short amendment to the MPA if required. If everything is straightforward we can turn this around in 48–72 hours.

Cheers,
Ben
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
---
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@launchpadaccelerator.com>; ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-10T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-cohort promo allocation — possible? (internal assessment + conditional approval)

Ben / Samir — looping in Programs and Legal lightly here. Laura from Programs — quick assessment below.

Summary of ask we got from Ben: apply ~$12,000 leftover promo from Cohort 05 to split between Cohort 06 (June) and Cohort 07 (Aug).

Programs position: supportive, provided the startup list matches the original program eligibility and usage remains consistent with onboarding goals.
Finance note (Marissa): we need to confirm there isn't a separate promotion tied to a partner or VC that requires reimbursement language.

Conditions for one-time exception (proposed):
1) Promo balance capped and reallocated only to named startups in June/Aug cohorts (we’ll need an explicit list).
2) Usage window: credits must be consumed within 90 days of reallocation.
3) Redwood to add a one-page amendment to the MPA stating the allocation and IDs.
4) No stacking with other Redwood promos; normal usage-based billing applies after credits are exhausted.

If Samir can confirm the exact balance and attach the participant list, Marissa and I will prepare the amendment. I’m attaching the standard short-form amendment template and the promo terms we typically reference.

Attachments: promo-terms-2027.pdf (PDF, 48 KB) — short-form amendment template included.

Next steps: Samir to reply with numbers + list; Ben to confirm any commercial ask (e.g., extended consumption window) we should consider.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head, Accelerator Programs | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
---
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@launchpadaccelerator.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@launchpadaccelerator.com
Date: 2027-05-11T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-cohort promo allocation — possible? (details)

Thanks Laura — appreciate the quick look. Confirming details below: 
- Remaining promo balance: $11,850 (MPA ref: LP-MPA-2027-05).
- Intended recipients: 8 startups (list pasted; internal names omitted here for privacy) — will send a signed CSV to contracts@launchpadaccelerator.com per your request.
- Expected pattern: small spike in week 1 of each cohort (bootstrap testing + model fine-tuning), then steady monthly usage.

We are comfortable with the 90-day consumption window, and the no-stacking clause is fine. Contracts will counter-sign the amendment as soon as your team sends it.

Could you confirm whether Redwood can split it evenly (50/50) across the two cohorts, or if you prefer prorating by cohort size. Either works for us but even split is simplest.

Samir
---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@launchpadaccelerator.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-12T18:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-cohort promo allocation — possible? (approved, amendment attached)

Samir — good to go. We’ll do a 50/50 split unless you instruct otherwise. Marissa confirmed accounting and legal has signed off on the short-form amendment. Attached is the amendment and the promo terms; please have your contracts team sign and return the signed MPA amendment to contracts@redwood.com. Once we receive the signed doc we’ll complete the allocation and notify the cohort teams.

Attachments: signed-mpa-LP-2027.pdf (PDF, 12 KB); promo-terms-2027.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)

Operational notes:
- Allocation: $5,925 assigned to Cohort 06 (June), $5,925 to Cohort 07 (Aug).
- Consumption window: 90 days from allocation date (we’ll stamp the allocation date in the amendment).
- Monitoring: we’ll share a token-usage dashboard link to the LaunchPad program inbox once allocation is live.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/LP-2027-038
DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/containers/receipt?envelopeId=abc123def

If anything changes on your side (cohort counts, startup roster), flag it ASAP — the allocation is bound to the signed amendment.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping these startups moving quickly.

Best,
